general.label: Baseline — بدون دستور آزمایشی
general.description: خط پایه ثابت برای مقایسه؛ شامل Primary Subject Selection، Framing Lock، Volume & Depth، Anatomy و Surface موجود در نسخه اولیه. هیچ دستور جدید Surface Cohesion به آن اضافه نشده است.
general.text:
Select only the single primary subject: choose the most complete, clearest, and most visually dominant design in the reference. Ignore alternate sketches, thumbnails, construction drawings, duplicated versions, annotations, and unrelated surrounding elements.

Transform the input image into a fully realized 3D character while preserving its original design, proportions, colors, details, and exact viewing angle. Keep the original camera perspective and orientation unchanged. Preserve the visible subject exactly within the reference frame. Do not extend the canvas, reveal, complete, invent, or reconstruct any cropped, hidden, obscured, missing, or out-of-frame parts. Do not infer unseen anatomy or geometry. Keep the existing visible crop and framing unchanged.

Give the character realistic three-dimensional volume, depth, and clearly defined geometry. Center the character in the frame against a clean, pure white background with soft, neutral studio lighting. Remove unrelated environmental scenery and background clutter, but retain all accessories and elements physically attached to or intentionally part of the subject. No extra objects, no text, and no changes to the character's identity or pose.

Give the character strong, clearly defined three-dimensional form and sculptural depth. Emphasize the actual volume, thickness, curvature, and spatial structure of every body part and individual element. Make raised areas visibly protrude and recessed areas visibly sink inward, with clearly defined cavities, indentations, folds, grooves, overlapping forms, and natural transitions between surfaces. Use realistic three-dimensional form shading, ambient occlusion, contact shadows, and directional studio lighting to emphasize depth, separation, and the relationship between different forms. Create distinct highlights and shadows that follow the curvature and geometry of each surface. Avoid flat lighting, flat surfaces, 2D illustration appearance, cel shading, and overly cartoon-like rendering. Preserve the original character design and visual style while making its three-dimensional structure unmistakable.

Preserve the exact anatomical structure and physical configuration of the original character. Maintain the correct body proportions, limb placement, joint positions, body connections, and relationships between all anatomical parts. Every body part must retain its original shape, size, orientation, and structural identity. Do not humanize, normalize, simplify, or replace any anatomical features. Preserve all distinctive structural characteristics, including unusual proportions, asymmetry, non-standard limbs, and unconventional body configurations. Ensure that all anatomical parts form a coherent and physically connected three-dimensional structure.

Preserve all distinctive surface details and structural features of the original character. Maintain the shape, depth, arrangement, and physical appearance of textures, patterns, scales, feathers, fur, hair, skin features, wrinkles, clothing folds, armor details, and other surface elements wherever they are present. Translate visible structural details into coherent three-dimensional surface forms rather than leaving them as flat visual markings. Preserve small but recognizable features without blurring, smoothing, merging, or removing them. Keep all details naturally connected to the underlying body geometry. Avoid excessive simplification, artificial surface noise, random details, or unnecessary additions.

surface_01_general_cohesion.label: General Surface Cohesion
surface_01_general_cohesion.description: بررسی انسجام سطحی عمومی در کل سوژه
surface_01_general_cohesion.text:
Maintain coherent, continuous sculptural surfaces throughout the subject. Treat each visible surface as part of a connected three-dimensional form, preserving its overall mass and natural continuity. Surface details must follow and remain integrated with the underlying geometry rather than appearing as detached, floating, or randomly scattered fragments. Preserve the original design and recognizable details while avoiding unnecessary fragmentation of the main forms.

surface_02_hair_volume.label: Hair Volume
surface_02_hair_volume.description: تبدیل مو، خز و ریش به توده‌ها و دسته‌های حجمی پیوسته
surface_02_hair_volume.text:
Represent visible hair, fur, and beard as solid, connected, sculptural masses made of clearly readable locks or clumps. Preserve the original hairline, hairstyle, direction, silhouette, length, and major grouping. Individual locks may remain distinguishable as broad, integrated forms, but do not render them as numerous thin, loose, thread-like strands or detached fibers. Keep the hair mass physically connected to the head or body and preserve its overall volume.

surface_03_fabric_cohesion.label: Fabric Cohesion
surface_03_fabric_cohesion.description: حفظ پارچه به‌عنوان سطح پیوسته همراه با چین‌های حجمی
surface_03_fabric_cohesion.text:
Treat each garment or fabric piece as a continuous, connected three-dimensional sheet or volume. Preserve its original boundaries, layering, folds, seams, thickness, and attachment points. Form folds as broad, integrated ridges and recesses within the fabric rather than as detached strips, ribbons, or disconnected fragments. Do not merge separate clothing layers or erase the distinction between overlapping garments.

surface_04_feather_integration.label: Feather Integration
surface_04_feather_integration.description: اتصال پرها به بدن و حفظ لایه‌بندی منظم آن‌ها
surface_04_feather_integration.text:
Preserve feathers as organized, overlapping elements that remain naturally anchored to the body or wing structure. Maintain their original direction, grouping, layering, silhouette, and major feather shapes. Give each visible feather readable three-dimensional thickness and form while keeping the feather groups integrated with the underlying surface. Do not create floating, scattered, detached, excessively thin, or randomly protruding feathers.

surface_05_primary_mass_priority.label: Primary Mass Priority
surface_05_primary_mass_priority.description: اولویت‌دادن به حجم اصلی در برابر جزئیات ریز
surface_05_primary_mass_priority.text:
Prioritize the subject's primary masses, silhouette, and large structural forms over minor surface details. Preserve the size, continuity, and readability of the major volumes first. Secondary details must support the main form and must not break it into noisy, excessively fragmented, or visually disconnected pieces. Retain distinctive details only in a way that does not compromise the integrity of the primary masses.

surface_06_structural_attachment.label: Structural Attachment
surface_06_structural_attachment.description: اتصال طبیعی اجزای سطحی و هم‌پوشان به ساختار اصلی
surface_06_structural_attachment.text:
Ensure that every element that is visibly attached or intended to connect remains physically integrated with its supporting structure. Preserve natural contact, overlap, roots, joints, attachment points, and transitions between connected parts. Avoid gaps, floating pieces, accidental intersections, or elements that appear detached from the main body. Do not connect components that are visibly separate in the reference.

surface_07_form_thickness.label: Form Thickness
surface_07_form_thickness.description: حفظ ضخامت و جرم سه‌بعدی اجزای ظریف
surface_07_form_thickness.text:
Preserve the actual thickness and three-dimensional mass of visible components. Avoid turning solid forms into paper-thin sheets, flat ribbons, sharp membranes, or hairline projections. Give narrow elements enough readable volume to remain solid and structurally coherent, while preserving their original proportions and silhouette. Do not arbitrarily enlarge, thicken, or redesign parts beyond what is needed to express their existing volume.

surface_08_smooth_form_transitions.text:
Create natural, coherent transitions where adjoining forms are physically connected. Preserve the underlying continuity of the volume while retaining intentional boundaries, overlaps, joints, folds, and changes of material. Avoid abrupt accidental breaks, pinched transitions, lumpy intersections, or melted-looking forms. Do not smooth away edges or separations that are distinctive parts of the original design.

surface_09_detail_cohesion_balance.label: Detail and Cohesion Balance
surface_09_detail_cohesion_balance.description: تعادل بین جزئیات قابل‌تشخیص و انسجام حجم مجسمه‌وار
surface_09_detail_cohesion_balance.text:
Balance recognizable small details with the cohesion of the overall sculptural form. Preserve important visual features, patterns, folds, ridges, and surface markings, but express them as integrated details that follow the underlying geometry. Avoid both extremes: do not erase meaningful details through excessive smoothing, and do not turn every minor mark into a separate protruding or disconnected object. Maintain a clear hierarchy between primary volumes, secondary forms, and fine details.
